cards.claim: V4 M1 proposes subject-only ellipsis: the picture silently supplies only “this plant” or “this apparatus,” while all other arguments remain in the card stream. The source judges the model parsimonious for Herbal but insufficient to explain why Biological pages sustain many short closed cells around multi-component drawings without repeatedly naming components, paths or endpoints, and it gives the f82r.3–4 boundary repeat no special function beyond a copied entry head. This is a historical competing grammar, not a decoded translation or lexical assignment.

evidence.quote:
### M1 — subject-only ellipsis

The picture silently supplies only “this plant” or “this apparatus.” All other
arguments must be in the card stream.

This is parsimonious for Herbal, but it does not explain why Bio can sustain
many short closed cells around a multi-component drawing without repeatedly
naming components, paths, or endpoints. It also gives the `f82r.3–4` boundary
repeat no special function beyond a copied entry head.
evidence.why: complete M1 definition, including its limits against Bio short cells and the f82r boundary repeat
